invariants.description: impact_id is deterministic from canonical mutation payload only; no timestamp, no random — same input always yields same impact_id.
Impact ledger is HMAC-chained (SHA-256, ADAAD_LEDGER_KEY); chain break → MIAChainError (fail-closed; no write proceeds).
CRITICAL or HIGH_RISK impact assessments emit HUMAN0_AUTHORISATION to CGTH before ledger append.
Analysis is restricted to the supplied mutation payload; MIA never reads live repo state or external filesystems during assessment.
Every impact record is immutable post-append; the ledger supports read and verify only — no deletion, no in-place update.
